title: The Badger’s Mountain Lending Library
description: On Borrowing Day, the badger lends an ibex a mountain small enough to carry home. The snow on its summit is due back with it.
alt: A bespectacled badger slides a tray with a miniature snowcapped mountain toward an ibex in a red scarf, beneath brick arches filled with tiny ranges.
pairing: An imagined Borrowing Day × a badger librarian who lends miniature mountains
